title: dee.sync.v1
description: A 'dee sync' on one account that changed something or failed: dee makes the host's systemd user units match its manifest (generated drop-ins and targets, enabling, starting, stopping, masking).  Emitted by producer 'dee'.  A sync that found nothing to do emits nothing.  Subject: the dee host name.

host.description: The host's name in the dee manifest (also the subject).

config.description: Absolute path of the manifest used.

actions.description: What was done to units, one line each, e.g. 'start syncthing.service', 'mask ssh-agent.socket', 'defer emacs@org-mcp.service'.

files.description: How many generated files were written or removed.

errors.description: What failed; empty when the sync succeeded.
